facts.fact: The Standards Association of Zimbabwe's accreditations page lists ZWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (information security management systems) as a Zimbabwe standard (ZWS) with a certification scheme; the page does not state the body's legal basis, and its own date is 2023-03-06 with content updated to February 2026, so February 2026 is the stated event date.

SAZ Certification Services, the certifier, states its ZWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ISMS) certification scheme was accredited to ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015 by the Southern African Development Community Accreditation Services (SADCAS) in February 2026; the page names no certified organisation.

systems.country_label: Standards Association of Zimbabwe; SAZ Certification Services
